curated_soundness_and_miscompilation_cat.title: x86-64 FFI bool return value miscompilation (missing 8-bit truncation / range metadata mismatch)
curated_soundness_and_miscompilation_cat.mechanism: Calling convention return widening/truncation mismatch between C caller/callee and LLVM range metadata.

curated_soundness_and_miscompilation_cat.title: Equal pointers compare unequal / miscompilation under GVN after integer-to-pointer cast or exposed provenance
curated_soundness_and_miscompilation_cat.mechanism: LLVM GVN replaces pointer p with q after `icmp eq p, q` even when p and q have distinct provenance (`llvm/llvm-project#34548`, `#35229`).

curated_soundness_and_miscompilation_cat.title: Self-referential generators/coroutines and `&mut T` where `T: !Unpin` violate LLVM `noalias`
curated_soundness_and_miscompilation_cat.mechanism: Unqualified `&mut T` uniqueness would invalidate self-referential `Pin<&mut Coroutine>` pointers if `noalias` were emitted without `Unpin`.

curated_soundness_and_miscompilation_cat.title: i686 / x86-32 returning `f32`/`f64` via x87 `st(0)` converts signaling NaN (`SNaN`) to quiet NaN (`QNaN`)
curated_soundness_and_miscompilation_cat.mechanism: System V i386 ABI and `extern "Rust"` on `i686` execute `flds`/`fstps` on return, quieting SNaNs in violation of RFC 3514 byte-preservation for value moves.

curated_soundness_and_miscompilation_cat.title: x87 80-bit excess precision on `i586` targets without SSE2 violates IEEE 754 `f32`/`f64` rounding
curated_soundness_and_miscompilation_cat.mechanism: x87 FPU instructions compute in 80-bit extended precision without per-operation rounding to `binary32`/`binary64`.

curated_soundness_and_miscompilation_cat.title: `i686-pc-windows-msvc` 8-byte stack alignment mismatch between `rustc` (`align_of::<u64>() == 8`) and MSVC C frames (4-byte stack alignment)
curated_soundness_and_miscompilation_cat.mechanism: Borrowing a stack-allocated `u64`/`f64`/`i64` in a frame without 8-byte stack realignment produces a 4-byte-aligned pointer when `align_of::<u64>() == 8`.

curated_soundness_and_miscompilation_cat.title: Implied bounds on function arguments allow lifetime extension (`transmute::<&'a T, &'static T>`) without `unsafe`
curated_soundness_and_miscompilation_cat.verified_mir_to_asm_effect: untouched_frontend (unless post-monomorphization borrow/lifetime checker is run)
curated_soundness_and_miscompilation_cat.mechanism: Higher-ranked function pointer subtyping manufactures `'static: 'a` witness without proving the witness type is inhabited.

curated_soundness_and_miscompilation_cat.title: Async function with uninhabited `!` parameter pattern miscompiles/crashes during coroutine lowering (`tests/ui/rfcs/rfc-0000-never_patterns/120240-async-fn-never-arg.rs`)
curated_soundness_and_miscompilation_cat.mechanism: Coroutine state-machine lowering emits invalid MIR drop/storage live sequences for uninhabited arguments.

curated_soundness_and_miscompilation_cat.title: `dyn AsyncFn*` wrong pointer size / metadata coercion (`tests/ui/async-await/dyn/wrong-size.rs`, `works.rs`, `mut-is-pointer-like.rs`)
curated_soundness_and_miscompilation_cat.mechanism: Unsized coercion of async trait objects passes mismatched fat/thin pointer layout to codegen.

curated_soundness_and_miscompilation_cat.title: MIR Optimization (`GVN` / `ConstProp` / `JumpThreading`) miscompilations found by `rustlantis` differential fuzzer
curated_soundness_and_miscompilation_cat.verified_mir_to_asm_effect: fixes (by running from `Runtime(PostCleanup)` at `-Zmir-opt-level=0` or verifying MIR passes against MiniRust/Anneal)
curated_soundness_and_miscompilation_cat.mechanism: Unverified MIR-to-MIR transformations in `rustc_mir_transform` folding pointer comparisons, overlapping assignments, or uninhabited branches unsoundly.
